text:
ravi: Quick sync 1: we found a medium CVE in one base layer (curl linked to old libssl). Planning a targeted rebuild for staging tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need RBAC tweak + signing decision.

anya: Can you list which SAs will change? I want to scope rolebindings.

ravi: runtime-staging-sa (remove cluster-admin), baker-staging (namespaced role), audit-writer-sa (new, restricted).

mina: KMS: for staging we can use cloud KMS with cosign --kms. Vault/HSM is overkill for this patch. Production stays Vault.

kms-bot: KMS key info: projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/staging-key (access limited).

anya: Gatekeeper change: drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN and CAP_NET_RAW, enforce seccomp default profile. I'll open a small PR.

sec-oncall: I'll be on-call during the window. If vuln-scan returns HIGH/CRITICAL, page me.

ravi: Short checklist: patch base, rebuild SBOM, run vuln-scan, sign with KMS, deploy 10% canary, monitor 10m, promote or rollback.

anya: ack. I'll add CI gate to fail on high/critical.

mina: ack. I will not touch prod keys.

ravi: thanks all, closing thread unless blockers appear.
